global.collision: AABB strict overlap; swept/substepped to prevent tunneling
global.hitPolicy: each obstacle counts at most once per attempt; no knockback; fail when mistakes > maxMistakes
global.coinPolicy: circle vs player AABB inclusive; once per attempt
global.timePolicy: simulation time only; paused during pause/background
global.successPolicy: reach length while time <= limit and mistakes <= max and coins >= required
global.finishPolicy: on reach length without enough coins, fail immediately
global.tieBreak: process collision/coins first, then failure for mistakes > max or time > limit, then finish
global.retryPolicy: reset time, position, velocity, mistakes, coins, obstacle phases and zones; rewards only once per completed attempt
